fields.name: id
fields.meaning: The finding's stable identity: its rule and every value that tells it apart.

fields.name: rule
fields.meaning: The rule that found it: dangling-reference, missing-reference, removed-end or unevidenced-opinion.

fields.name: subject
fields.meaning: The entity the finding is about, as a person reads it.

fields.name: target
fields.meaning: What the finding names beside its subject: the missing key, the removed end or the producer.

fields.name: cause
fields.meaning: Why the finding stands, in plain words.
fields.example: the to end of code.contains is removed

fields.name: severity
fields.meaning: How serious the finding is: blocker, critical, major, minor or info.
